The Kaikki, WikDict and Wiktionary dictionaries are built from Wiktionary text written by the Wiktionary contributors (https://www.wiktionary.org/) and were modified by OpenMDict (filtered, restructured, lookup keys and redirects added; see each description). Wiktionary text published since June 2023 is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (and the GFDL), so the Kaikki.org extracts of February 2026 and WikDict release 2025-11 are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (WikDict's DBnary dataset states CC BY-SA 3.0, whose section 4(b) allows adaptations under a later version). The two Wiktionary TSV dictionaries come from a November 2022 snapshot (Vuizur/Wiktionary-Dictionaries, built from Kaikki.org / Wiktextract data), when Wiktionary text was dual-licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 and the GFDL, and keep that licensing.
